A few good bread questions.

How does shipping work?

Multi-packs ship free to the 48 contiguous states. A physical delivery address is required; Jim’s cannot ship to PO boxes. Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico have additional shipping charges.

Can I freeze the other loaves?

Yes. Keep a loaf for now and freeze the others for later. Jim’s FAQ describes the bread as staying fresh for up to 21 days without preservatives.

Is this bread gluten-free?

No. Jim’s bread contains wheat and gluten and is not suitable for people with celiac disease. Check the product ingredients before ordering.

Are all the varieties made the same way?

The six-ingredient list shown here is for the original Whole-Cell Wheat loaf. Other varieties have different ingredients. Each linked product page has its own details.
